title: Bounded-above flat module complexes are K-flat
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and let P^\bullet be a bounded-above cochain complex of flat R-modules, where flat means that tensoring with the module preserves exact sequences. Then for every acyclic cochain complex L^\bullet of R-modules, the total tensor complex Tot(L^\bullet \otimes_R P^\bullet) is acyclic; equivalently P^\bullet is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: Convert the explicit upper bound to IsStrictlyLE and termwise Module.Flat to ObjectProperty.flat using ModuleCat.flat_iff_flat. Modules have exact filtered colimits (transport the AB5 instance along AsSmall.equiv) and tensor-right preserves colimits by the braided closed structure. Apply the proved upstream CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat. Use HomotopyCategory.kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic to tensor an arbitrary acyclic L on the right with P. The quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_acyclic equivalence identifies the result with acyclicity of mapBifunctor L P. The upstream theorems are closed generic tools, and no unit-level argument is replaced.
